bagPolicy.summary: Photo City Music Hall hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Photo City Music Hall is in a plaza with a large attached parking lot that all fans can use. The lot entrance is off Culver Road.
parking.quote: We have a large parking lot attached, available for all patrons to use.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Photo City Music Hall. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The bar serves a variety of drinks with themed specials that change every show, but the venue does not serve food. Outside drinks are not allowed, though you can eat delivered food on the outside porch.
concessions.quote: We do not serve food. We do have an outside porch where you can eat if you get food delivered though!

accessibility.summary: Photo City Music Hall is fully wheelchair accessible, with ramps onto the sidewalk in front of the entrance. It is mostly a standing room space, so ask any staff member if you need a chair.
accessibility.quote: Yes, we are fully handicap & wheelchair accessible. There are ramps to get onto the sidewalk in front of entrance.

reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry for events. If you need help with this, talk to security.
reEntry.quote: There is No Re-Entry for our events, if you need assistance with this please let our security know.

ticketPickup.summary: Age limits vary by show, and each event listing says whether it is 16+, 18+ or 21+, so check the event page before you buy. The venue is open on show nights only.
ticketPickup.quote: It varies by show. Each event listing specifies Ages 16+, 18+, or 21+. Check the individual event page before purchasing.

gates.summary: Photo City Music Hall hasn't published doors and entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.
